sourceNotes.rawContent:
Product Description:
Make a bold style statement with the Interlocked Circle Knot Ring for Women. Featuring intertwined circles encrusted with sparkling stones, this ring beautifully symbolizes unity and sophistication. The elegant design adds a touch of modern glamour to any outfit. With the Interlocked Circle Knot Ring for Women, celebrate meaningful moments and timeless style every day.
Why You Will Love It:
✨ Symbolic interlocked design for added significance
✨ Shimmering pavé stones create eye-catching sparkle
✨ Comfortable and adjustable fit for everyday wear
✨ A perfect gift for birthdays, anniversaries, or special occasions
Highlights / Specifications:
🔹 Material: High-quality, durable alloy for lasting wear
🔹 Plating: Premium gold plating for a luxurious finish
🔹 Stone Type: Dazzling cubic zirconia stones
🔹 Design: Modern interlocked circle knot with pavé accents
🔹 Size/Fit: Adjustable design to suit most finger sizes
🔹 Best Use: Suitable for daily wear, party wear, or gifting
Care Instructions:
💎 Clean gently with a microfiber or polishing cloth
🚫 Avoid chemicals, water, and ultrasonic cleaners
🛑 Remove while swimming, showering, or gardening
🌡️ Store in a cool, dry place away from extreme temperatures
Perfect For:
🎁 Gifting on Weddings, Birthdays, Valentine's Day, Festivals
👭 Teen girls, daughters, sisters, and fashion-forward women
💃 Matching with western and ethnic outfits for a glam touch
